description: Reviewed outcome for every value selected from an external (URL) source and for every pending field whose open question is an external technical source (review of 2026-11-11). One entry per product x property. 'expect' pins the record as reviewed; external_review.py stops if the record has changed. Outcomes: confirmed = the value was re-read on a copy whose identity is established (registry SHA-256 match, a saved evidence copy with a verified hash, or a live supplier data feed corroborated by the archived TDS), and product, property, unit, qualifier, conditions and page agree with the record; inconclusive_source_unavailable = no copy of the source could be obtained in this review, so the value was not re-read (an earlier registry check is reported, not repeated). Nothing in this file changes product data; corrections found here are declared in source_selection.py.

observations.text: The byte-verified Aramco sheet prints 'Noack Volatility (Procedure B) | wt% | D 5800 | 7.5'; the record's DL2-12172.pdf prints a maximum of 7. A typical above the specification maximum is logically incompatible: recorded as conflict EVR-2026-11-11-230-noack (not resolved; the selected value is unchanged).

The Aramco sheet prints 'Density @ 15 °C | kg/L | D 4052 | 0.8635', a third value beside DL2-12172.pdf (0.8630, no unit) and DL2-11773.pdf (0.8625, provisional). Recorded as conflict EVR-2026-11-11-230-density-external; the field stays pending.

The MOGO flyer prints 'Sp. Gravity, 15/4 °C | ASTM D 4052 | 0.834' for BAPbase 4. Not filled: outside the reviewed value set, and whether distributor-issued external documents may fill Missing fields is a policy decision.
